text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1851234567 — elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate across us-west-2. Service: inference-runtime. Paging on-call Alice. Link: https://observatory/redwood/incidents/1851234567

Alice: Oncall, stepping in. Thanks for ping. Starting live triage. Any immediate mitigation suggestions?

Bob: I see the spike. Error class is 502/503 from runtime-proxy, downstream timeouts to runtime pods. Tail logs are sparse for the timeslice — sampling was reduced in the last config push.

Carla: Pulling runtime pod logs now. Quick snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:23:11Z error runtime.ProcessRequest: kv-cache-miss, upstream timeout after 120s
2026-03-15T10:23:12Z warn shard=3 retries exhausted
```

Carla: full tail failing because query returns partial due to sampling. Frank, can you bump sampling for inference-runtime to 100% for the incident window?

Frank: Confirmed. Sampling for service=inference-runtime set to 100% from 1851234300 to now. Note: metrics retention ok but some trace spans were never instrumented for this path.

Dan: Hypothesis A: KV cache eviction bug after quantized model rollout -> increased cold calls causing timeouts. Hypothesis B: routing change sent requests to a smaller instance type with slower kernel.

Emma: Support here. Customer delta-ai reported timeouts and retries. Affected SKUs: realtime-api 3 customers showing elevated error rates. ETA on mitigation?

Grace: Started a rollback of the recent routing change that adjusted capacity pools. Command used:
```
platformctl rollback-routing --service inference-runtime --to-revision rev-2026-03-12-abc123
```
Grace: Also temporarily increased pod replicas from 6 -> 12 to reduce queueing.

Bob: Rolling change looks healthy so far. 5xx rate down ~40% after scale and rollback. Still seeing some residual timeouts.

Alice: Handoff to Bob for the next two hours — I'm leaving for Ops rotation. Summary: rollback routing, sampling bump, scaled pods, customer-impacting errors noted. TODOs left: collect full request traces, verify whether KV cache TTL change coincided with model rollout, and capture any missing dashboard metrics.

Bob: Acknowledged. I'll drive RCA. Steps I'm going to run now:
- export all runtime logs for 1851234200-1851235100
- run ad-hoc query to find requests hitting shard=3
- correlate model-version header with error rate

Bob: Ad-hoc query that failed earlier because of sampling limits (now works after bump):
```
SELECT timestamp, pod, request_id, model_version, status_code
FROM logs
WHERE service = 'inference-runtime' AND timestamp BETWEEN 1851234200 AND 1851235100
AND shard = 3
ORDER BY timestamp ASC
LIMIT 5000
```
Carla: Pasted a full stack snippet where kv-cache returned null which caused a long blocking call to storage layer.

Dan: Noted we deployed a quantized variant 36 hours ago that changed caching key shape in memory. Could be mismatch causing cache misses.

Frank: Observability gap: the traffic enrichment job that attaches model_version label to logs was silently failing due to a schema change; about 30% of logs during the window have model_version=null. That explains some blind spots. Logged issue: OBS-789.

Hector: CS update: two enterprise customers opened tickets; one has active sessions timing out, they flagged SLA. Sent initial incident communication and mitigation steps.

Bob: Creating live timeline in the incident board and will attach exported logs. Quick hypotheses list in-thread:
1) cache key schema mismatch after quantized model rollout -> higher cold misses -> slower downstream storage calls -> 5xx
2) routing change moved traffic to smaller instance family -> increased P90 latency and queueing -> timeouts
3) sampling and enrichment failures created blind spots making diagnosis harder
4) unrelated storage flakiness causing intermittent timeouts

Bob: Action items assigned:
- Carla to dump KV cache metrics and PR the cache schema diff (in progress)
- Dan to validate quantized model key changes (in progress)
- Frank to restore enrichment pipeline and backfill model_version labels for 48h window (high priority)
- Grace to confirm rollback is fully propagated across regions (in progress)

Alice: Thanks team. Leaving notes in the incident doc and flagged for postmortem. Everyone add relevant logs and queries to the incident board. :white_check_mark:

Bob: Closing live mitigation loop for now; monitoring for 30m. Will post follow-up RCA plan and timeline once backfilled data available. :mag:
